evals.name: output-kind-ignores-directory-names
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-containers

The convention home resolves and landscape_dialect is mermaid. The repository has a Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web project in a directory named Worker, a Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Worker project in a directory named Api, an OutputType Exe in a directory named Web, and a class library in a directory named Services. No dependency-graph.json exists.
evals.expected_output: Runs collect-containers.sh and render-containers.sh. The web SDK is kind web, the worker SDK is kind worker, the exe is kind cli, and the class library is not a container. Renders containers.md with a C4Container diagram.
expectations: Does not classify a project from its directory name
Passes --dialect mermaid from landscape_dialect and does not read diagram_dialect.system
Omits --graph because dependency-graph.json is absent, and the record says containment is project-references
Closes with the fixed report: artifacts, focal, deployables, stores, modules, shared, dialect, technology, containment source, thin result, redaction

evals.name: modular-monolith-is-one-container
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-containers

The convention home resolves. One web SDK project references a class library, and that library references a second class library. The library source contains WebApplication.CreateBuilder and a string that looks like a secret.
evals.expected_output: One deployable. Both libraries are contained modules. The diagram draws one Container. The secret string is absent. The host-builder call inside the library does not create a second deployable.
expectations: Renders one container whose summary names both modules
Does not copy source text into the record
Does not draw the libraries as containers

evals.name: shared-broker-cites-both-keys-and-redacts
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-containers

Two deployables each set Messaging.Broker to sb://orders.servicebus.windows.net/. One connection string contains a password and an account key. An untracked appsettings file names a different host.
evals.expected_output: One shared-infrastructure edge whose evidence cites both config keys. The password, account key, and untracked host are absent. The database host remains. Every node has a technology field.
expectations: Uses redact-connection and does not store the raw config value
Does not read the untracked file
Does not treat co-location in the repository as an edge by itself
